'''Taryn Zel''' was an [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] in [[Hapan Security]] in [[41 ABY]], the daughter of a half-brother of [[Isolder]], making her the first cousin of [[Tenel Ka Djo]], the [[Queen Mother]]. She was the identical [[Twin/Legends|twin]] of [[Trista Zel]], and the two were very valuable officers to Tenel Ka. She later became engaged to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Zekk]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:TarynTrista_Zel.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Taryn and her twin sister, Trista]]
Taryn and Trista were born to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] sibling of [[Isolder]] sometime around [[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]].<ref name="Age" /> When they reached adulthood, Taryn and Trista became [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] in [[Hapan Security]], and due to their close relations with Tenel Ka, were very useful operatives to her. Nobody knew of their close relationship to Tenel Ka, and they were given their own security team to help them out during missions.

===Retrieving Ben===
After the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] had escaped [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], Taryn and Trista were tasked by [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] to retrieve him and return him to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base on [[Shedu Maad]]. After waiting about eight standard hours on [[Nova Station]], the twins finally encountered Ben and took him to their skiff.

However, on the way to meet up with Isolder at the rendezvous point, Isolder's ship came under attack by the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], and the prince was captured. The twins then took Ben directly to Tenel Ka to inform her of her father's capture.

After Tenel Ka's ship, the ''[[Dragon Queen]]'', dropped Ben off at the Jedi base, Taryn took an interest in [[Zekk]], who was standing nearby. Trista scolded her sister for indulging in such behavior while on duty, but Taryn shrugged it off.

Later on, the twins and Ben Skywalker were assigned to defend Shedu Maad against an attack by the ''Anakin Solo''. The pair were shocked to hear that a [[Nanovirus|nanokiller]] had been released on the ''Dragon Queen'', killing all those on board with royal blood, and refused to answer Ben's questions as to whether or not Tenel Ka and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] were among the casualties. Shortly after, the twins and Ben uncovered a plot by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Livette]] to betray the Hapan crown by allying with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Remnant]]. Trista volunteered to stay behind and keep an eye on the traitor, and Ben and Taryn went after the Remnant troops and their leader, [[Tahiri Veila]]. Taryn would later help Ben bring Tahiri into custody.

===Reappearance===
Six months after the [[Battle of Uroro Station]], Taryn reappeared after a period of absence, romantically involved with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]]. She would answer no questions about where she had been or why she had not reported Zekk's survival to the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> She also participated in a successful [[Raid on Detention Center 81|mission]] to free [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]],<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> and later in [[Operation Shieldfall]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].

==Personality and traits==
Taryn enjoyed making jokes and slight flirting, much in contrast to her sister Trista, whom she chided for being a [[Dug/Legends|dug]].

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Taryn Zel first appeared in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' along with her sister [[Trista Zel|Trista]].<ref name="Invincible" /> She was scheduled to appear in the novel ''[[Blood Oath]]'' by [[Elaine Cunningham]] along with Trista and the Jedi [[Zekk]] before the novel was cancelled.<ref name="coffeespill">{{SWBoards|url=message.jspa?messageID=17427002#17427002|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-11-06|time=10:24 AM}}</ref> However, upon her next appearance in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', it was revealed that she and Zekk were in a relationship together, which would have been a development from the novel.<ref name="Backlash" />
